A fresh ledger with only a `set` row (`period=1w, horizon=6w`) and a `team` row, run at 08:00 on the anchor Monday, one hour before the first shift. DESIGN 5.2 raises the snapshot to the anchor (09:00) and to the team row, so the snapshot lands at 2026-06-01T09:00 with an empty roster (the team row at the same instant sorts after the snapshot per 3.6). Six weekly slots up to the horizon boundary 2026-07-13 are filled round robin alice, bob, carol, dave, alice, bob because every score is zero and the `order` tiebreak walks the roster from the top, then from the member after the previous assignee.
